description:
A Real-time Watchlist & Price Alerts Engine
Build: WebSocket-based live price streaming with user-defined watchlists and configurable price / percentage alerts delivered via push and email.
Key features:
Create / reorder / delete multiple watchlists
Live tick updates with up/down colour flashing
Alert rules: above/below price, % move, 52-week high/low
Notification delivery + alert history log
Stretch: Indicator-based alerts (e.g. "RSI crosses 70"); throttling & de-duplication.
Skills tested: Rea

A Real-time Watchlist & Price Alerts Engine
Build: WebSocket-based live price streaming with user-defined watchlists and configurable price / percentage alerts delivered via push and email.
Key features:
Create / reorder / delete multiple watchlists
Live tick updates with up/down colour flashing
Alert rules: above/below price, % move, 52-week high/low
Notification delivery + alert history log
Stretch: Indicator-based alerts (e.g. "RSI crosses 70"); throttling & de-duplication.
Skills tested: Real-time systems, WebSockets, event-driven design, state management.
Production leverage: The alerting service becomes a standalone reusable microservice; watchlists are a day-one retention feature.
